title: Graded quasi-isomorphisms compare every step of a finite filtration
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and f:K→L a filtered map of uniformly finite decreasing filtrations on integer cochain complexes of R-modules [def-kun-finite-filtered-module-homotopy]. If every associated graded map gr^p f is a quasi-isomorphism, the underlying map and every restriction F^p f are quasi-isomorphisms. No cochain-degree bound is required.

source.place: Tags 012K, 012M, 012O, 012P, 012W; Derived Categories Tags 05S2 and 05S3; Categories Tag 04VK.

proof.text: For every p form the short exact sequences F^(p+1)→F^p→gr^p and their morphism induced by f. Restriction squares commute after the monic step inclusion; quotient squares commute by their projection equations. The long exact sequences and five lemma show that quasi-isomorphisms on F^(p+1) and gr^p imply one on F^p. Lean uses the proved source helper HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.quasiIso_τ₂ in WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.BicomplexColumns, implementing exactly this argument.

Above a common upper zero-filtration bound, both step complexes are zero, so every step map is a quasi-isomorphism. Descending induction over the finite interval to any specified p gives all step quasi-isomorphisms. At a common lower whole-filtration bound the step inclusions are isomorphisms to the underlying complexes, giving the underlying quasi-isomorphism.

theorem finiteFilteredModule_graded_comparison {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {K L : FiniteFilteredModuleComplex R} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (hg : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (FilteredObject.gradedMapSteps f.hom p)) :
    QuasiIso f.hom.hom ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (FilteredObject.restrictionSteps f.hom p)
